contract: Callers retain a LoadLibrary reference, quiesce WGL/window-message users and destroy every context before shutdown or recreation.
Native workers hold releasable ICD/frontend references; the native acceptance path uses explicit shutdown rather than a permanent module pin.
Shutdown refuses live contexts/in-flight admitted work. All lifecycle control APIs refuse loader callouts.
Recreate initializes a clean WGL frontend; native GPU initialization is lazy and may fail on subsequent context creation. SCREEN status stays clear until actual screen creation.
Applications recreate their GL objects after a reset; prior object contents are not restored.
runtime_lifecycle.surface_loss: Native window SwapBuffers rejects destroyed or mismatched window/DC identity.
runtime_lifecycle.barrier_ownership: Only the final departing Windows queue-barrier participant receives one-shot destruction ownership.
runtime_lifecycle.gpu_reset_qualification: No physical GPU TDR/reset was triggered; native destroyed-window recovery is qualified.
